contracts.acquisition_presentation: Only exact pickup/featured banner relationships are promoted visually. Ordinary pool memberships are counted compactly and preserved losslessly under Technical evidence.
contracts.banner_locale: Exact English banner assets are preferred, then neutral assets, then other locales. No gacha ID or banner filename is hardcoded.
contracts.cdg_images: Dedicated CdG imagery is used only when exact source evidence exists. Otherwise exact granting-weapon art is labelled as contextual fallback.
contracts.cdg_recast_timing_policy: The recast timing column is preserved as unresolved Technical evidence and is never presented as a gameplay cooldown without runtime proof.
contracts.damage_coefficient_label: Projectile attack damage values are shown as internal damage coefficients per hit, not final damage.
contracts.echonomist_policy: Coup de Grâce Echo eligibility is derived from the exact m_action ActionFlagType.SpecialAttackConsecutiveShot flag. Runtime-created echo attacks are marked with AttackFlagType.SpecialAttackEcho (4294967296).
contracts.equipment_filters: Weapon, armour and accessory facets and normal-progression comparison stats are derived from the equipment semantic model.
contracts.future_capture: All skills, variants, levels, Coup de Grâce records, tags, elements and backlinks are enumerated from captured tables/models. No individual skill, weapon, Memory, vocation or special-attack ID is embedded in the browser renderer.
contracts.legacy_links: Every raw pick-skill ID, nested ability ID, grouped family ID and raw Coup de Grâce ID is emitted as a navigation alias.
contracts.level_control_policy: The browser uses prominent level tabs for short progressions and a styled dropdown for longer ones.
contracts.semantic_variants: Mechanically identical captured rows collapse by normalized level/mechanic signature; all source IDs and ability IDs remain under Technical evidence.
contracts.skill_decoder: Every captured skill level is traversed through its complete m_ability graph. Supported ability, buffer, projectile, projectile-attack, heal, barrier, status and timing tables are decoded generically; unresolved tables remain explicit in Technical evidence.
contracts.technical: Internal ability component rows remain under Technical evidence; player-facing pages use localized descriptions and decoded mechanics only.
contracts.variants: Duplicate player-facing names are grouped into semantic families while exact IDs remain selectable and preserved under Technical evidence.
contracts.version_history: Skill/Coup de Grâce presence is recalculated from both certified masterdata versions rather than inherited from obsolete normalized entity IDs.
